title: External communications timeline and action register for multi-region capacity regression
creator: Alyssa Chen
description: Post-incident runbook and customer-facing communications schedule for the multi-region capacity regression on 2025-01-30. This ticket centralizes the external timeline, status page content drafts, targeted customer outreach plan, and a prioritized list of engineering action items that feed into the RCA and follow-ups.
incident_summary: On 2025-01-30 03:40 UTC a capacity regression impacted request acceptance and increased tail latency across eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Traffic surges combined with an autoscaler config change caused sustained queueing and degraded throughput for ~2.5 hours. Several customers reported increased 5xx rates and timeouts. The control plane remained live but some routes hit fallback behavior resulting in partial failures for batched streaming requests.
timeline: 2025-01-30 03:20 UTC - Early signs: elevated queue lengths observed in eu-west-1 metrics
2025-01-30 03:40 UTC - Error spike and latency increase crossing page-routed alert thresholds
2025-01-30 03:45 UTC - Incident declared; on-call and infra responders paged
2025-01-30 04:05 UTC - Autoscaler rollback to previous config completed; partial throughput restored
2025-01-30 05:00 UTC - Regional fallback policy enabled for critical routes to reduce cross-region failover
2025-01-30 06:10 UTC - All primary routes stable; investigation continued into root cause
2025-01-30 09:00 UTC - Initial customer advisory posted on status page and emailed to top 25 affected orgs
2025-02-02 10:00 UTC - Preliminary mitigation RFC published; action items created and prioritized
root_cause: A misapplied autoscaler parameter change introduced an aggressive scale-down threshold for GPU-backed pools during short-term load variability. This accelerated node reclamation under bursty traffic, causing increased request queueing and cascading fallback to model-variant routes that were not optimized for streaming/batched workloads. Contributing factors: incomplete canary for autoscaler change, no regional pre-warm policy for GPU pools, and lack of an early-warning synthetic test for tail-latency under batching conditions.
immediate_mitigation: Rolled back autoscaler config to last-known-good, enabled temporary capacity reservation for affected GPU pools, and applied a short-lived regional pre-warm to smooth bursts. Status page message and direct emails to high-impact customers issued within 5 hours of detection.
long_term_mitigation: Introduce autoscaler change gating: automated canary run + rollback window for any scaling-related config
Implement regional pre-warm and soft-reservation policy for GPU pools handling streaming workloads
Add synthetic tail-latency tests that exercise batching + KV cache eviction scenarios on a schedule
Enhance routing to prefer model-variant fallbacks that preserve streaming/batch compatibility
Create a playbook for targeted customer outreach and SLA credit assessment

ENG-24605 - Add synthetic tail-latency probe for batching + KV cache churn (owner: Miguel Santos) - due: 2025-02-21
ENG-24606 - Update routing fallback table to include streaming-compatibility tags and automatic gating (owner: Lila Nguyen) - due: 2025-02-28
ENG-24607 - Draft customer SLA impact assessment and outreach templates for finance/legal review (owner: Maya Ortiz) - due: 2025-02-12
ENG-24608 - Postmortem review session with Support, Sales, and Product to finalize customer messages (owner: Alyssa Chen) - due: 2025-02-11
communications_plan: Status page: Craft two-tier messages: (1) concise incident summary + current state for public audience; (2) technical deep-dive to be published with RCA
Customer emails: Personalized notes to top 25 most affected orgs including timeline, mitigation steps taken, expected follow-ups and contact for escalation
Blog/RCA: Publish a detailed RCA and engineering action list once long-term mitigations are scoped and scheduled (target: within 3 weeks)
Support playbook: Update canned responses and SSO escalation paths for customers requesting credits or SLAs
Press/Partners: Coordinate with comms for partner marketplace notices if broader visibility arises

2025-02-06 09:00 UTC - Cross-functional customer comms rehearsal with Support and Product Marketing
